subject.title: fix(plugins): refresh stale source plugin registry (#96046)

question: Should this PR be held for live Gateway startup proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the focused registry test as sufficient for this compatibility-sensitive bug fix?
rationale: The patch is a plausible narrow fix, but it changes persisted registry fallback behavior on a user startup path and the PR body explicitly says the live Gateway flow was not tested.

options.title: Require live Gateway proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, logs, or screenshot showing a stale persisted registry plus global extensions memory plugin no longer rejects plugins.slots.memory at gateway startup.

options.title: Accept focused test proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally waive the external real-behavior proof gate and rely on the added registry regression test plus green checks.

recommendation.title: Require live Gateway proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, logs, or screenshot showing a stale persisted registry plus global extensions memory plugin no longer rejects plugins.slots.memory at gateway startup.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent plugin registry and snapshot work makes this the best available owner for judging the registry fallback proof bar.
